_setup: console.cloud.google.com > APIs & Services > Credentials > Create OAuth client ID.
Web application, authorised redirect URI http://localhost:3000/callback.
Google publishes its issuer as both spellings below, and a token can carry either,
which is why `issuer` here is a list. There is no client_credentials grant for a
normal OAuth client, so `service` is omitted: that path needs a service account.
There is no password grant and the login form is not scriptable, so the user flow
is skipped and only the unattended checks run.
